title:
Comment of Teri Diamond in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/3/2026

documents.name: 152237.txt
documents.text:
Teri Diamond, Sterling, AK.
I am writing to oppose the plan for the hyper scale data center in the narrowest section of Cook Inlet, a pristine ecosystwm and home to marine life with sensitivity to warm water. 
Not only will it have  great environmental impact on an endangered species which are in strong recovery stage after years of intervention, but also an economic impact on our salmon fisheries. 
Anybody familiar with echolocation has got to understand the noise impact.
This is not the kind of "progress" we want for Alaska. Keep your data center out!
